meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. WHEN: event hub SDK error, service bus SDK issue, messaging connection failure, AMQP error, event processor host issue, message lock lost, message lock expired, lock renewal, lock renewal batch, send timeout, receiver disconnected, SDK troubleshooting, azure messaging SDK, event hub consumer, service bus queue issue, topic subscription error, enable logging event hub, service bus logging, eventhub python, servicebus java, eventhub javascript, servicebus dotnet, event hub checkpoint, event hub not receiving messages, service bus dead letter, batch processing lock, session lock expired, idle timeout, connection inactive, link detach, slow reconnect, session error, duplicate events, offset reset, receive batch.

copy.tagline: 排查并修复Azure消息服务SDK的连接与处理故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在使用Azure事件中心或服务总线时遇到SDK错误需要快速定位
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对 Azure Event Hubs 和 Service Bus 的 SDK 报错进行排查:识别 SDK 及版本、检查命名空间健康状态、匹配错误信息、检索 Microsoft Learn 文档、核对连接字符串与实体配置,最后给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当问题涉及 Azure Event Hubs 或 Service Bus 的 SDK 报错、连接失败、认证错误等时触发。

say.text: 我收到 event hub 连接失败,怎么排查?
say.note: Claude 会按诊断流程开始排查。

say.text: Service Bus 消息锁过期了,怎么办?
say.note: Claude 会检查锁续期配置并给建议。

say.text: 我的 Python Event Hubs SDK 报 AMQP 错误,帮我看看。
say.note: Claude 会匹配错误并查文档。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will troubleshoot Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK errors: identify SDK and version, check namespace health, match error messages, search Microsoft Learn docs, verify connection strings and entity config, then suggest fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the issue involves Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus SDK errors, connection failures, authentication errors, etc.

say_en.text: I'm getting an event hub connection failure, how do I troubleshoot?
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the diagnostic workflow.

say_en.text: My Service Bus message lock expired, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will check lock renewal and recommend fixes.

say_en.text: My Python Event Hubs SDK reports an AMQP error, help me debug.
say_en.note: Claude will match the error and search docs.
